statute_title: First Schedule to the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (Authoritative Classical ASU Texts)
legal_significance: Under Section 3(a) of the Drugs & Cosmetics Act, 1940, only formulations manufactured in accordance with recipes in these 56 books qualify as Classical ASU Drugs without requiring Rule 158B safety trials. Under Section 3(p) of the Patents Act, 1970, all recipes in these 56 books constitute anticipation in prior art.
